capabilities: collect all checkbox tasks in the vault into one overview note via a code block
group tasks into four statuses and by source note
cycle checkbox states between to do, done, dropped, and later
hide individual tasks or whole notes without editing the files
open a task's source note by clicking it
extras: Hidden task data is stored in the plugin's data.json; the overview renders only on demand and needs a manual Refresh after edits; localization follows the app language (Chinese or English).
intentEvidence: Obsidian's checkbox flips between empty and x. This plugin cycles through four
problem: Obsidian checkboxes only flip between two states and there is no built-in way to see every task in the vault gathered in one place.
summary: Task overview plugin that scans the vault's Markdown checkboxes into one code-block note grouped by status and source, with four-state cycling.
